entry.title: 7 June 2018: material takeover of control without a CAM possession order
entry.summary: The direct eyewitness’s judicial statement describes a broken lock, chains, padlocks, replaced cylinders, uniformed access control and continuing exclusion. The 16 April order directed no possession or eviction. The authority later accepted was the insolvency administrator’s authority to the Community—not a CAM judicial possessory title.

entry.title: Webinar, OB REM and JSP units: unitary title control
entry.summary: The brochure’s “under study” label does not neutralise the categorical November 2020 webinar claims. The record now also controls the 31 properties separated through the OB REM operation, applies Sun Park Judgment 89/2014 to individual title, and publishes the 61-property JSP/Monte Lanza schedule.

entry.title: Four non-estate units: PwC control and Monte Lanza title chain
entry.summary: A new visual panel covers four private units represented by name in 2016, three by PwC professionals and one by Patricia Domínguez. It publishes Gil Marer’s attributed criminal allegation, the property-by-property question, and analysis of Monte Lanza’s conditional deed, 2017 Registry records and CAM attribution in 2018.

entry.title: Complete index: PwC meeting of 11 June 2016
entry.summary: 176 consolidated contextual interventions by FMMM and Juan Carlos Prieto are published with all six attendees, key statements and the 2021–2023 PwC UK–PwC Spain notice trail. Gil Marer’s normalisation or whitewashing allegation is separated from proved facts and outstanding internal evidence.

entry.title: Dedicated dossier: instrumentalisation of the Community
entry.summary: A new bilingual page covers the Community authority chain, Pamanil and Pamalexsha, the PropCo/OpCo structure, the PwC/Landwell engagement and the transcript of the recorded 2016 meeting. Carlos Saavedra’s public chronology is linked with express evidential limits.

entry.title: 2011 as documentary ground zero and 22 June as the matrix minutes
entry.summary: The reconstruction separates the voluntary 2008 prehistory from the FMMM era; identifies the 22 June 2011 minutes as the document joining debt, voting exclusion, Pamanil, custody and litigation; follows the chain through 2022; publishes Gil Marer and Patricia Domínguez’s perspective correction; and distinguishes the 2008 asset transfer from the 2011 purchase of LPB shares from Multimatrix.

entry.title: “The Community” no longer operates as a shortcut to authority
entry.summary: New visual stop and documentary matrix: the label Community, president or administrator does not prove appointment, resolution, mandate, unit scope or verification. The 10 March and 7 April Cabildo records and the 18 June 2026 communication are separated by what each establishes and does not establish.

entry.title: 2021 prosecution route: referral of the file containing the RIC allegations documented
entry.summary: The LexNET receipt identifies the website, webinar and RIC annexes. The 12 and 22 March 2021 orders document notification and subsequent referral of the proceedings to the Public Prosecutor. The individual prosecutor and merits assessment remain undocumented.

entry.title: 2021 alert: substance, recipients and established receipt
entry.summary: New visual map of the 2021 sequence: CNMV and AEAT received direct filings; the insolvency case received, served and placed the chronology before the judge; the administrator and personated parties were notified; the 12 and 22 March orders document notification and referral to the Public Prosecutor; the individual prosecutor and merits assessment remain open. The alert connected title, investors, RIC, the estate, bidding and a circular risk of later validation.

entry.title: Protected report, court filing and the verifiable duty to react
entry.summary: The review distinguishes whistleblower protection from judicial evidential admissibility. The record shows procedural responses but identifies no substantive reconciliation, Article 40.1 LEC referral or Article 82 TRLC supervision report. Non-response may be a procedural breach; it does not prove collusion by itself.

entry.title: Knowledge, decisions and title: the 2021–2022 procedural chain
entry.summary: The chronology documents formal knowledge by the administrator and judge, incompatible orders, clarification, operative certified copies, deed and registration. Gil Marer attributes functional alignment with the CAM-favouring result; no clandestine agreement or offence is stated as proved.

entry.title: Prior notice, surviving Matkator title and current public exposure
entry.summary: CNMV and AEAT were notified in January 2021; the insolvency court received the title and marketing objection in February. CAM/RICPE later acknowledged fragmented ownership, while Matkator’s registered title survives and the operation and public exposure continue.

entry.title: Corrected: Sun Park/MYND materialisation and loans are documented
entry.summary: The audited accounts record Series F and G and EUR 6,573,703.10 materialised and lent to HNT; the BOE records a EUR 3,440,914.20 regional award. The remaining question concerns the truth and sufficiency of the eligibility file.

entry.title: AC and judge journey made static and directly navigable
entry.summary: Both language versions now show a static AC and judge section after the five private actors, with direct navigation and no JavaScript dependency.

entry.title: DIP 2/2026: documented appeal-status error
entry.summary: Court records predating Fiscalía's check already documented appeal RPL 3319/2025. The complete 11 March communication and its contextual explanation are now published.

entry.title: Law 2/2023: formal routing to the Canary Islands Government's internal system
entry.summary: The signed receipt establishes transfer of REGAGE26e00065752755 for treatment under Law 2/2023 and Decree 91/2024, together with outgoing record 681432/2026. A redacted copy is published; it is not a merits decision.

entry.title: Accountability sequence reordered
entry.summary: The five private actors now precede the insolvency administrator and judge to improve causal legibility, without establishing liability or automatic neutrality.
